//go:build upgradeseed

package reqstore

import (
	"os"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

// TestUpgradeSeed seeds a snapshot DB at $UPGRADE_SEED_DB using this tag's store API.
func TestUpgradeSeed(t *testing.T) {
	path := os.Getenv("UPGRADE_SEED_DB")
	if path == "" {
		t.Skip("UPGRADE_SEED_DB not set")
	}
	s, err := Open(path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	base := time.Date(2026, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 0, time.UTC)
	recs := []*Record{
		{ID: "req-1", ItemType: "movie", ItemID: "mov-1", TMDBID: 603, Title: "The Matrix", Year: 1999, Poster: "/p/matrix.jpg", Status: "available", CreatedAt: base, RequestedBy: "alice@example.com", Overview: "A hacker learns the truth.", GenresJSON: "[\"Sci-Fi\"]", QualityProfileID: "hd-1080p"},
		{ID: "req-2", ItemType: "movie", TMDBID: 27205, Title: "Inception", Year: 2010, Status: "pending", CreatedAt: base.Add(time.Hour), RequestedBy: "bob@example.com", Overview: "Dream heist.", GenresJSON: "[\"Sci-Fi\",\"Thriller\"]"},
		{ID: "req-3", ItemType: "episode", ItemID: "ep-9", TMDBID: 1396, Title: "Breaking Bad", Year: 2008, Status: "denied", CreatedAt: base.Add(2 * time.Hour), RequestedBy: "carol@example.com", DenyReason: "already owned elsewhere", SeasonNumber: 2, EpisodeNumber: 5, Overview: "Chemistry teacher.", GenresJSON: "[\"Drama\"]"},
	}
	for _, r := range recs {
		if err := s.Put(r); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if _, err := s.db.Exec(`UPDATE requests SET updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?`, r.CreatedAt.Add(time.Minute).Format(time.RFC3339Nano), r.ID); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	for _, id := range []string{"req-1", "req-3"} {
		if ok, err := s.ClaimReadyNotified(id); err != nil || !ok {
			t.Fatalf("claim %s: %v %v", id, ok, err)
		}
	}
	if err := s.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
